1.h3 h5 2.g4.strategy: Gives a pawn away for nothing: 2...hxg4 wins it, and 3.hxg4 would open the h-file for 3...Rxh1, winning the rook. White's kingside is left loose and there is no compensation for the pawn.
1.h3 h5 2.g4.name: Clemenz Opening: Spike Lee Gambit
1.h3 h5 2.g4.background: Its association with the filmmaker Spike Lee probably has no direct connection. No tournament game with the gambit is on record.
